clips.title: The story
paras: This quest offers a second chance for shamans completing their spiritual trials along the coast of Silverpine Forest. If a shaman's spirit-sight fades before communing with the purified manifestation of water, Tiev Mordune stands by to rekindle the communion. By providing another Water Sapta, the petitioner can witness the ritual anew and finish their communion.

The path to mastering water is fraught with delicate spiritual timings. Shamans drink a potent draught known as a Water Sapta to perceive the spirits lingering around the elemental shrines. Should the draught's magic lapse before the shaman speaks with the Minor Manifestation of Water, they find themselves locked outside the spirit realm, unable to complete their trial. Fortunately, fellow shaman Tiev Mordune lingers on the fog-shrouded shores of Silverpine Forest to assist those whose visions ended too soon.

Tiev Mordune, having already conquered the corrupt water spirit lurking off the coast, waits with his gathered ritual remnants. He requires proof of readiness in the form of a fresh Water Sapta from Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. Once presented with the sapta, Tiev casts his gathered bracers and droplets into the shrine's brazier, summoning forth the pure manifestation once more so his fellow shaman can speak with it and seal their elemental bond.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetin's, friend! Have you too come to purify the waters here and prove your understandin' to Islen?
I've just defeated the corrupt water spirit meself, and I'm just 'bout to put da bracers and remaining drops o' water on the brazier.
What's dat? Ahhh. Tiev understan' all too well when somethin' goes wrong. Well, Tiev can help you plenty if you be needin' to see the pure water spirit again.
Bring me a water sapta from Islen as proof that you be ready, an' I'll wait to turn in me parts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I know another that had trouble after defeating da corrupt water spirit--seems he waited too long and he came out of the spirit world too quick fer his taste. Hate to see dat happen to another, so I'll just wait here fer a bit to make sure no one else be needin' me help.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'll put me items in the brazier den, and you c'n talk wit' da spirit too.
An' dontchu worry none 'bout seein' into da spirit world wit' da sapta... Ol' Tiev know a trick or two 'bout how da sapta magic works.
Come now, head down wit' me to the shrine and let's speak to da spirits together, friend.
